subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be split so the heartbeat wake precedence bug is fixed first while Telegram default DM isolation stays governed by `session.dmScope`, or should Telegram DMs change their default session behavior too?
rationale: The heartbeat precedence path is a concrete bug, but changing default Telegram DM routing conflicts with documented main-session continuity and can affect existing users.

options.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
options.body: Fix or adopt the event-triggered heartbeat session routing change now, and leave Telegram default DM isolation as a separate compatibility decision.

options.title: Bundle Telegram default isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs away from main-session default behavior as part of this work, with explicit upgrade notes, docs, and tests for users relying on continuity.

options.title: Defer to per-session heartbeat design
options.body: Hold the fix behind the broader native per-session heartbeat scheduling direction, accepting that the current forced-session contamination path stays open longer.

recommendation.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
recommendation.body: Fix or adopt the event-triggered heartbeat session routing change now, and leave Telegram default DM isolation as a separate compatibility decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main heartbeat-runner maintenance makes this the best available code-owner signal for the heartbeat half of the decision, though product authority is not proven.
